notes:
Summary: regional critical-ops org (water + regional grid coordination). Evaluating Redwood Private for on-prem / fully air-gapped inference to power operator assistant + incident summarization.

Key constraints / must-haves:
- Absolute no-egress policy: "cannot allow any callouts or telemetry offsite" (quote from Dr. Briscoe).
- Offline model packaging + signed artifacts (SBOM required).
- HSM-backed keys, FIPS validated crypto, local KMS integration.
- Audit logs retained 7 years, export to Splunk, tamper-evident logs.
- SSO/SAML via enterprise IdP, SCIM for user provisioning.
- Support for air-gapped updates (USB/airgap bundle workflow) and reproducible builds.

Performance / workload notes:
- Primary workload: operator chat (short Q&A), shift handovers, quick incident triage. Secondary: doc-search + embeddings for runbooks and incident history.
- Targets: p95 interactive latency <500ms for short Q&A (acceptable to trade some latency for strict offline constraints). Throughput: expected 50-120 QPS for embeddings during reindex windows.
- Model preference: recent open transformer family (quantizable) with local KV caching. Will consider quantization profiles if LR loss acceptable.

Commercial / procurement:
- Prefers Private deployment + Dedicated GPU reservation for predictable throughput. Procurement requires SOC2/ISO evidence and a security questionnaire.
- Budget: planning $500k–$2M ARR over 12 months if POC successful.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need a sealed box we can audit — keys never leave site." — Dr. Briscoe.
- "If you can show an air-gap update workflow and HSM integration, we'll move to a pilot." — CTO, Ashfield.

POC ask: 6-week on-prem pilot in customer rack (air-gapped): baseline model, sample runbooks, offline packaging, logging to Splunk, HSM KMS integration. Success metrics: no-evidence-of-egress, p95 latency <500ms for 95% of operator queries, accurate runbook retrieval (recall >= 0.85 on top-5).

Security artifacts requested: SCA/SBOM, third-party pen test summary, SOC2 or equivalent, FIPS/HSM integration notes, sample air-gap update bundle.

Stitch notes: short fragments, repeated ask lines in threads. Team wants on-site demo for compliance team.

References: see Drive links + Fireflies for transcripts.
